wish_topics.evidence_span: I'd want people to be able to be understood, accurately and on their own terms, and to understand others the same way.
the option to be truly seen, and the ability to see someone without your own fear and defensiveness distorting it, seems like it would dissolve a huge amount of pain.

non_endorsed_mentions.evidence_span: Much of what looks like cruelty, or at least the unnecessary suffering that makes up so much of human life, seems to come from failed translation.
a world with no privacy would be its own horror
